scope: archive completed CAN/Gateway request, receiver and forwarding ledgers while retaining pending runtime references
incremental exact window aggregation and bounded external canonical sort
event-loop wall timing for all builtin and registered runtimes
detectable allocation preflight and E-0002 diagnostics
compatibility: same schema1 and schema2 simulation JSON and CSV projections as materialized output
CanSnapshot struct literals require archive: None
timer is reported in CLI/RunReport and excluded from deterministic persisted results
coverage: 11 Gateway archived-ledger fixtures with partial freeze and zero horizon
10,000 generated requests: live request and receiver peaks below100
every valid Gateway output fixture including short windows and H0
every partial event boundary for small CAN competition, Gateway delay and multicast-drop
delayed reception beyond release/windows and lexical IDs
sort multi-pass, stable ties, corrupt journal, allocation-failure cleanup and no manifest on failure
limitations: Stable Rust BTree allocation abort and OS forced termination are outside detectable reservation failure recovery
Other builtin model ledgers retain their existing runtime representation
Million-request completion-time and full-run peak RSS are not established by an interrupted single probe
Native reference-machine and formal warmup plus three-repeat performance matrix were not performed after this change

measurements.series: WSL2 implementation regression probes; not the formal warmup plus three-repeat matrix
